title: stats.json
description: Per-batch L3 statistics output (scheme §5). Two parts: (1) DESCRIPTIVE summaries over the pair sets (self = C(m,2) unordered; cross = A×B cartesian, not doubled) — per channel: mean, median, IQR, n_eff, plus self-consistency, separation(A), distinctiveness(A), and the LORO leave-one-run-out sensitivity (min–max + valid-drop count, the ONLY sensitivity量; bootstrap bands deleted). (2) The SINGLE inferential procedure permitted: the P-min/P-q quality-instruction randomization test — per-config exploratory (exact Ω_c enumeration, granularity 1/|Ω_c|) and the pooled MAIN test (B_perm=10000, p=(b+1)/(B_perm+1), per-hypothesis seed_h stream, strict null propagation → p=null, Holm with null假设 excluded from ranking but the FULL pre-registered family size k as step-down denominator). DESCRIPTIVE-ONLY: this schema carries statistics and p-values, NO inferential CLAIM fields (no significant/reject/winner/effect-size interpretation — banned by scheme §0/§2 no-scoring + lint). Diagnostics c-ncd/d-tagpath are EXCLUDED from all statistics and hypothesis families (scheme §4), so only the 15 formal channels appear here. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme §5 fixes the statistics byte-exactly but not the JSON shape; the layout is this contract's design. This file ENTERS the §8 verify rehash → runner fixes one canonical float serialization (CONTRACT-NOTES §6/§8). schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. Determinism (FLAGGED): numbers typed as JSON numbers for readability but the file feeds a verify rehash — runner fixes one canonical serialization (CONTRACT-NOTES §8). Seed domains: per-hypothesis seed_h = uint64_le(SHA256(b"perm\0"‖NFC(hypothesis_id))[0:8]) XOR 20260716 (CONTRACT-NOTES §6); zero stream sharing. Holm family + hypothesis IDs are frozen in the lock BEFORE any p is emitted (scheme §5/§11).

configs.description: Config ids in the manifest's PERSISTED array order (§4); every use site takes this order verbatim.

formal_channels.description: The 15 FORMAL channels (scheme §4). The 2 diagnostics c-ncd / d-tagpath are permanently excluded from statistics and never appear in this file.

descriptive.description: Descriptive statistics, one entry per prompt variant present (P-min / P-q). Within-variant (scheme §9 default analysis).

self_consistency.description: Per (config, formal channel): the self pair set C(m,2) descriptive stats. self-consistency := mean of non-null S on the self pair set (scheme §5). Eligibility n_eff≥4; m=1 → self=null; m=0 → absent (config omitted). (config_id,channel) composite uniqueness runner-enforced.
Mean of non-null self-pair S (scheme §5 self-consistency); null when ineligible.

mean.description: Arithmetic mean of non-null S on the self pair set (== self_consistency; mirrored for symmetry with cross).

median.description: Median of non-null S (the /matrix diagonal display value, DESIGN §5); null when ineligible.

n_eff.description: Count of non-null S on the self pair set (scheme §5).

cross.description: Per (config_a, config_b, formal channel) for a<b in persisted order: the cross pair set A×B descriptive stats (mean = arithmetic mean of non-null S; scheme §5). Eligibility n_eff≥4 ∧ m_a≥2 ∧ m_b≥2. (config_a,config_b,channel) composite uniqueness runner-enforced.

config_a.description: Precedes config_b in persisted config order (§4).

separation.description: separation(A) per (config, formal channel) = mean(intra A self) − mean over B of sim(A,B) (scheme §5). B set = every OTHER pre-registered config meeting cross eligibility, equal-weight. Eligibility = self n_eff≥4 ∧ B set non-empty; coverage = |B| / (pre-registered config total − 1), denom 0 → null, coverage <80% → value null. exploratory (folded by default, §7).

value.description: separation(A); null when ineligible or coverage<80% (scheme §5). Not bounded to [0,1] (it is a difference of means).

coverage.description: |B|/(registered−1) as a canonical decimal string, or null when denom 0. Value forced null when this is <0.8.

b_set_size.description: |B set| — count of eligible other configs.

registered_total.description: Total pre-registered config count (denominator base = this − 1).

distinctiveness.description: distinctiveness(A) per (config, formal channel) = 1 − max over B of sim(A,B) (scheme §5). B set / eligibility / coverage / null rules identical to separation. Carries the nearest-neighbor config; ties → NFC UTF-8 byte-order smallest config_id. exploratory (folded).

nearest_config_id.description: argmax_B sim(A,B); tie → NFC UTF-8 byte-order smallest config_id (scheme §5). null when no eligible value.

randomization_test.description: The single §5 quality-instruction sensitivity test (P-min vs P-q). Unified statistic T_{config,h}: channel h → self_consistency_q − self_consistency_min; L1-scalar h → mean_q − mean_min (either side ineligible / no valid run → null). Re-randomization draws a fresh assignment in Ω_c (§1.2 encoding), re-labels the outcome by (block, time-position), recomputes T from scratch.

B_perm.description: Pooled Monte-Carlo permutation count (scheme §5 / appendix A).

holm_family.description: The pre-registered Holm family = full list of pooled hypothesis_ids, frozen into the lock BEFORE any p is emitted (scheme §5/§11). Its length is the step-down denominator k.

family_size_k.description: k = |holm_family| = FULL pre-registered family size. Used as the Holm step-down denominator EVEN when some hypotheses have p=null (null假设 excluded from ranking but k stays full — scheme §5 conservative).

per_config.description: Per-config EXPLORATORY test (scheme §5): exact full enumeration of Ω_c (N=5 → |Ω_c|=20, no MC). Two-sided p = #{ω: |T(ω)|≥|T_obs|}/|Ω_c| (observed included in Ω). p=null if T_obs=null OR any ω gives T(ω)=null. Granularity 1/|Ω_c| annotated. exploratory only (scheme §10).

T_obs.description: Observed T_{config,h} (q − min). null when either variant side is ineligible/no-valid-run.

p.description: Two-sided exploratory p; null per the null-propagation rule.

omega_size.description: |Ω_c|. For N∈{3,4,5}: N=3→6, N=4→6, N=5→20. Tightened to enum per DECISIONS-M0.5 §1 (catches miscomputed |Ω_c|; never rejects valid data).

p_granularity.description: Reported granularity 1/|Ω_c| (e.g. '1/20' for N=5), scheme §5 '如实标注'.

pooled.description: Pooled MAIN test, one entry per pooled hypothesis (scheme §5). mask_h = the frozen complete config_id list (missing/failed configs stay in the mask under strict null propagation). Strict null pre-check: exhaustively compute T_{config,h}(ω) over mask × all ω∈Ω_c BEFORE sampling; ANY null → p=null, no sampling. Otherwise B_perm=10000 draws, T_pool(ω)=equal-weight mean over the mask, b=Σ 1[|T_pool(ω_j)|≥|T_pool(ω_obs)|], p=(b+1)/(B_perm+1).

hypothesis_id.description: Locked pooled hypothesis id; MUST be in holm_family.

mask_h.description: Frozen pooled mask (scheme §5/§11): the complete config_id list (build-time NFC UTF-8 byte order, persisted; failed configs NOT removed) + its list hash.

config_ids.description: Persisted config order (§4); use sites never re-sort.

hash.description: Lowercase-hex SHA256 of the config_id array's canonical JSON (JCS), same discipline as manifest mask_h (CONTRACT-NOTES §4).

seed_h.description: uint64 per-hypothesis PRNG seed = uint64_le(SHA256(b'perm\0'‖NFC(hypothesis_id))[0:8]) XOR 20260716 (scheme §5 / appendix A). Independent stream, zero sharing.

omega_size.description: |Ω_c| for the batch N (N=3/4→6, N=5→20). Tightened to enum per DECISIONS-M0.5 §1.

precheck_null.description: true iff the exhaustive mask×Ω pre-check found any null T → sampling skipped, p=null (scheme §5 v11 穷举预检).

T_pool_obs.description: Observed pooled statistic T_pool(ω_obs) = equal-weight mean of T_{config,h}(ω_obs) over the mask; null iff precheck_null (⇔ any T_obs undefined).

b.description: Σ_j 1[|T_pool(ω_j)|≥|T_pool(ω_obs)|] over B_perm draws; null when p=null (not sampled).

p.description: (b+1)/(B_perm+1), or null under strict null propagation.

holm.description: Holm step-down result. null假设 (p=null) are EXCLUDED from the ordering but the denominator stays the FULL pre-registered family size k (scheme §5, conservative). NO significance/reject verdict is stored (descriptive-only).

rank.description: 1-based ascending-p rank among NON-null hypotheses, or null when this hypothesis is excluded (p=null).

adjusted_p.description: Holm-adjusted p (step-down with denominator k − rank + 1, cumulative max), or null when excluded. A p-value, not a claim.

excluded_null.description: true iff p=null so the hypothesis was excluded from ranking (k unchanged).

formalChannel.description: The 15 formal channels (scheme §4). Diagnostics c-ncd / d-tagpath are excluded from all statistics.

iqr.description: Inter-quartile range via linear interpolation, IQR=P75−P25 (appendix A). null when ineligible.

loro.description: Leave-one-run-out sensitivity (scheme §5): the ONLY sensitivity量 (bootstrap bands deleted). A valid drop needs self remaining run≥2 / cross both sides non-empty AND remaining non-null pair≥1; after dropping, n_eff≥4 is NOT re-checked. Reports the min–max of the recomputed statistic across valid drops + the valid-drop count. null when ineligible or fewer than 1 valid drop.

min.description: Minimum recomputed statistic across valid drops.

max.description: Maximum recomputed statistic across valid drops.

hypothesisTarget.description: The quantity h the test statistic is built on: a formal channel (T = self_consistency_q − self_consistency_min) OR a version-locked L1 scalar (T = mean_q − mean_min). Exactly one of channel / l1_scalar is non-null, per kind.

channel.description: Formal channel when kind=channel, else null.

l1_scalar.description: Version-locked L1 scalar id (e.g. colorfulness, brightness, contrast, whitespace_ratio, frame_change_median) when kind=l1-scalar, else null. Exact set locked in the Holm family (scheme §11).
